summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`NestDex`。它把灵巧操作拆成可复用的内层手技能与由视觉语言模块驱动的外层技能选择，核心仍然是多指灵巧手的真实遥操作与任务执行，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This run found 1 newly public, highly relevant work: `NestDex`. It decomposes dexterous manipulation into reusable inner hand skills plus a vision-language-driven outer skill selector, and the core contribution remains real teleoperated dexterous hand execution, so it is included in this update.

items.title: NestDex: Nested Policy Learning with Copilot-Assisted Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation
items.authors_or_org: James Zhao, Jinhe Tang, Mingyuan Ba, Weiming Zhi
items.relevance: 它把灵巧操作作为核心问题，围绕多指手的遥操作、内层手技能学习和高层技能选择展开，而不是把手只当作附属末端执行器。
items.relevance_en: It treats dexterous manipulation as the central problem, organizing the work around multi-finger hand teleoperation, low-level hand-skill learning, and high-level skill selection rather than treating the hand as a peripheral end-effector.
items.novelty_signal: 2026-08-13 首次公开的 arXiv 论文，提出嵌套策略式的灵巧操作框架，并明确引入 copilot-assisted teleoperation 与视觉语言技能路由。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public arXiv paper on 2026-08-13, introducing a nested-policy dexterous manipulation framework with copilot-assisted teleoperation and vision-language skill routing.
items.analysis_zh: NestDex 的主要工作是提出一种嵌套策略框架，把灵巧操作中的低层手部技能学习和高层技能选择统一起来。它解决的问题是：真实灵巧任务既需要稳定可复用的手内操作能力，又需要根据环境与指令在多个技能之间切换，而单一端到端策略往往难以兼顾这两点。方法上，作者通过 copilot-assisted teleoperation 收集数据，学习可重用的 inner hand skill，再用视觉语言模块在外层做技能路由，从而把复杂任务拆成可执行子技能。公开材料表明作者在真实灵巧操作场景中进行了验证，并展示该层级设计有助于任务分解与执行控制。结果显示这种嵌套式组织能提升可控性和一定的泛化能力；但当前公开信息对具体任务基准、对照方法、定量结果和硬件配置披露不足，因此还难以判断其相对现有灵巧操作系统的绝对优势。
items.analysis_en: NestDex’s main contribution is a nested-policy framework that unifies low-level hand-skill learning with high-level skill selection for dexterous manipulation. It tackles a concrete problem: real dexterous tasks need both reusable in-hand competence and the ability to switch among skills based on scene context and instructions, while a single end-to-end policy often fails to balance those requirements. Methodologically, the authors collect data with copilot-assisted teleoperation, learn reusable inner hand skills, and use a vision-language module to route skills at the outer level, decomposing complex tasks into executable subskills. The public materials indicate validation in real dexterous manipulation settings and suggest that the hierarchical design improves task decomposition and execution control. The reported results point to better controllability and some generalization benefits, but the public information is still sparse on the benchmark suite, baselines, quantitative metrics, and hardware setup, so the work’s absolute advantage over prior systems remains hard to judge.

caveats: 本轮按增量更新处理，仅纳入 2026-08-13 首次公开且满足“灵巧手/灵巧操作是核心贡献”的条目。
检索优先使用了 arXiv 作为主源；公开材料对实验细节与定量结果披露有限，因此分析保持保守。
